stopping_rules.rule: Exactly128 natural functions, then one reverse-order reuse and seven positive/four negative fixed control mechanisms; never stop after a favorable outcome.
One2GiB process and120s process watchdog protect the host. Preserve every completed/partial record; a process stop is unknown/not_completed and is not a mathematical empty set.

invalidation_rules: Any factor/product/point/signed-row/kernel/dense-rank mismatch marks its arm failed and is retained.
No unresolved divisor enters the complete rational graph.
Missing raw cases, missing control mechanisms or source/seed drift cannot be repaired by discarding data or rerunning the same attempt until success.
All clocks wall_valid=false; setup, factorization, checker, graph and verification counters are not a complete ECDLP cost.

decision_rule.text: Report exact raw finite counts and independent invariant agreements only. Seven positive and four negative controls are required for a clean correctness panel. A/A structural ranks must agree; DAG/reduction counts may differ. No hypothesis verdict or statistical inference.
decision_rule.threshold: Zero mismatches; planned control coverage complete.
decision_rule.statistic: Exact set/certificate/rank equality and retained all-case counts
decision_rule.interval: None: exact computations on fixed declared inputs; no population confidence interval.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: No performance effect; natural finite fractions retain their exact numerators/denominators.

graphs: All128 recorded anchored sections by anchor: rational/nonsplit/failure counts; no timing graph.
